findings.title: Rebuild the compiled Studio proof consumer before shipping the cache fix
findings.description: The Dockerfile inherits compiled Sitef11/SDK64e Next server chunks and replaces only four external SDK directories. Studio publication-simulation imports proof-simulation-node into its Webpack server graph; it is not an external module at runtime. Exact final5c961 chunk96429.js module44950 contains the old uncached reader, and its proof backend invokes that inline H factory. The separate packaged b524 state reader is fixed, but actual Studio does not use it. Therefore standalone SDK/native-driver tests cannot establish that this image fixes the Studio timeout.
findings.repro: Run the recorded no-network UID999 read-only image probe and inspect actual chunk96429.js; hash441f46351ad4853d597af842a7339ad82f57eeba803e4437121e003b9cf47988; old reader starts near byte124950 and proof branch calls H near byte131430.
findings.requiredCorrection: Build the actual Next app against SDKb524, or use a supported external proof-runtime module and rebuild. Verify the resulting compiled consumer uses the fixed reader before native/UI/deployment acceptance. Do not patch emitted minified code or relabel the old build.
